data.short_meaning: From the Greek 'δελφός' (delphos) meaning 'womb' or 'fetus' or 'dolphin'
data.long_meaning: In Greek mythology, Delphos was the name of the god Apollo when he was born from the womb of Leto. It also refers to the fetus or unborn child. In some Greek dialects, Delphos was also the name of the dolphin, making the name a fitting choice for a child born near the sea or for one who is playful and lively.
